title: How to organise the blanket and comfort zone | Family Room
description:
Hold the throws and floor cushions people actually reach for while watching or reading, in a container that tells the truth about how many there are.

This is the Blanket and Comfort Zone in the Family Room. About 15-30 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
One basket holding four throws folded to the same rectangle so the fold edges line up, two floor cushions stacked beside it, and nothing draped over the sofa back, the radiator, or the arm of a chair.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Hold every throw up to the window light.
Straighten: One basket, and the rim is the limit.
Shine: Wash everything in the basket, including the throws that look clean, because this is where pet hair and popcor
Safety: Look at where blankets end up when nobody is folding them.
Standardize: The count is one throw per regular seat plus one spare.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
One basket, one throw per regular seat plus one spare, every throw folded to the same rectangle, and no blanket left over a radiator or a heater.
